errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the verb types. The figure captions distinguish between '支配动词' (dominant verbs) in chart (a) and '承受动词' (patient verbs) in chart (b), not '配符词' (collocates/matching words).

errors.text_span: 包括新闻、科技、政令、教育、文学、公文、社科、广告和口语等
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates categories on the x-axis. The actual categories are 新闻 (News), 传统文学 (Traditional Literature), 网络小说 (Web Fiction), and 微博 (Weibo).
The description of the horizontal axis completely omits the sub-categories '男性' (Male) and '女性' (Female) that are present for each main corpus category.
In figure (a), the tallest bar has a value of 6783, which is significantly higher than 'approaching 6000'.

errors.text_span: 其中文学类别的蓝色柱状图最长
errors.evidence: In figure (b), the longest bar is in the '网络小说' (Web Fiction) category, not the '文学' (Traditional Literature) category.
This phrasing is ambiguous. It is the total stacked bar that is the longest, not just its blue segment. The blue part is the largest segment within that bar.
